title: settenantvariable action
description: Sets a tenant variable, which the flows of a tenant share, to the value of an expression. Variables are kept in memory.

path.title: Variable
path.description: Name of the variable, from the URI (<step>:<name>)

language.title: Language
language.description: Language of the value: simple, constant or xpath (the text of the first node it selects in the body)

encrypt.title: Encrypt
encrypt.description: Accepted for compatibility; variables in memory are not encrypted

protectedValue.title: Protected value
protectedValue.description: Accepted for compatibility; has no effect

groupName.title: Group
groupName.description: Accepted for compatibility; has no effect

flowName.title: Flow name
flowName.description: Accepted for compatibility; has no effect
